items.hyp: Marco Ballerini, ssente yagamba nti okusinziira ku kunoonyereza kw'abantu abalina ebikolebwa kujja kujja kujja kwongera okukola.
items.ref: Marco Ballerini, akulira pulojekiti yagambye nti mu kukola ekyo abantu abalina obukugu bajja kukulemberamu enkulaakulana y'omu maaso.

items.hyp: Ekizibu ekyo kisobola okukola mu bitundu bya disitulikiti mu Gulu e Gavumenti yasooka nga Jjuuni 25 ne Jjulaayi 25, kisooka okukola mu Jjulaayi.
items.ref: Pulojekiti egenda okukolebwa mu magombolola agasukka amakumi abiri mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu yatandika nga abiri mu ttaano Ogwomukaaga era ya kukomekkerezebwa ng'abiri mu ttaano Ogwomusanvu.

items.hyp: Abantu mu bantu abo mu Gulu balina okuba nti ebyo ebyali bisinga.
items.ref: Abantu b'omu bitundu by'e Gulu pulojekiti gyeeri mu kukolebwa kati basanyufu nnyo.

items.hyp: Baali baagamba nti abo abalala bangi baali baakola mu UPDF.
items.ref: Baanokolayo nti abamu ku bannaabwe baayingizibwa eggye lya Uganda People's Deforce Force.

items.hyp: Abaali bavunaanyizibwa okuba n'ab'okwerinda okusinga okukola enkola eno, era n'okukozesa enkola enkola ey'omu Moslem.
items.ref: Abalala baalina ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda bye baalinako akakwate ebyabayambanga okulondoola n'okumanyisa Abasiraamu.

items.hyp: Aba ADF 2, Kakooza Ahmad ne Dada Mukibi baali baasalawo okukola ssente.
items.ref: Bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces babiri, Kakooza Ahmad ne Dada Mukibi bammiddwa looni.

items.hyp: Ofiisi ya kwa ssimu n'okutambula akalala mu Kitante ekikulu kya kiyinza okukola ku kibiina kya ADF tekyali kikoleddwako.
items.ref: Woofiisi ekola ku kunoonyereza n'okulondoola e Kitante eyali ekola ku kutabaganya enkola za ADF yali tekyakola.

items.hyp: Okusinziira ku bakozi ba gavumenti, ebikolwa bya ADF bya kisobola okukola.
items.ref: Mu kukola ne Gavumenti, obulamu bwabwe bubadde bwongedde okuteekebwa mu katyabaga okuva eri bannaabwe ba Allied Democratic Forces abakyali mu nsiko.

items.hyp: Baatandika okuba nga ly'obubaka nga Lyavaala, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.
items.ref: Baayogera ku kufa kw'ekibwatukira okwa bannaabwe nga Lyavaale, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.

items.hyp: Abamu ku bantu baali bakolagana n'abo abavubuka ba ADF baawagira nti baali bafunye obulumbaganyi obw'okuba baali bafunye obulumbaganyi obw'okuba baali bawagira mu ngeri ya ADF.
items.ref: Abamu ku bannaabwe battibwa mu ngeri etaategeerekeka era abamu ku baaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baatiisatiisa okuttukiza ebikolwa y'obutujju.

items.hyp: Mu Okitobba 2008, abakulembeze b'ekitongole kya ADF baali bakyakolebwa gavumenti eyo olw'okuba baali bakolagana n'abo abali mu kibiina kya ADF abaali bakyakolebwa gavumenti.
items.ref: Mu Gwekkumi gwa 2008, abakulira ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda baasisinkana okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga y'abaliko abayeekera ba ADF balumiriza gavumenti okubakozesa.

items.hyp: Mu kibiina kya ADF baamubuuza gavumenti okukola ne bakulembera okubaako.
items.ref: Abaaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baalumizizza gavumenti okubakozesa n'ebasuulawo nga tebasasudde.

items.hyp: Mu Jjulaayi 11, bbomu ezaabwatukira mu Kampala zaakwatibwa n'abatujju ba ADF ne Somalia okuva mu bbomu aba Al-Shabaab abaali bakozesa.
items.ref: Obulumbanyi bwa bbomu obwali mu Kampala nga 11 Ogwomusanvu bwava ku nkolagana wakati wa ADF ne bamukwatammundu Abasiraamu aba Al-Shabaab abasangibwa e Somalia.

items.hyp: Olw'okuba abantu abo abaalina ebikwata ku by'obulamu, abo abaalina ebikwata ku abo abaali bavuganya mu kibiina kyabwe.
items.ref: Olw'embeera enzibu era ey'okwennyamira gye bawangaaliramu, bannamawulire ba Allied Democratic Forces abatamanyi kiddako baddiziddwa mu bikolwa by'obutujju.

items.hyp: Abdusalam Lukwebe ne be bamu ku abo abali ku abo aba ADF be baali bamu.
items.ref: Abdusalam Lukwebe Mwebe n'abalala be bamu ku baali bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces.

items.hyp: Aba ADF baali bakyaliwo nga Jjulaayi 2010 bwe yali agamba nti abakazi ba ADF tebakyaliwo kufuna obuyinza era naye ne bawagizi ba gavumenti.
items.ref: Independent w'Ogomusanvu, 2010, yawandiika nti abooluganda b'abaaliko mmemba wa ADF tebafuna buyambi kyokka ng'abaami baabwe baafiira ku mirimu gya Gavumenti.

items.hyp: Akakiiko k'Oku Ntikko kanoonyereza nnyo okuba n'obuyinza mu Kampala.
items.ref: Kampala City Council Authority lubeerera ekubiriza bannakampala okuba abayonjo.

items.hyp: Ebyo ebyali bimutuufu nga Rwigyema Shafik ne Tumusiime Hassan ebikolwa ebyo bye bimutuufu.
items.ref: Ekino kiviiriddemu bannaabwe nga Rwigyema Shafik ne Tumusiime Hassan ebuzibu.
